headline: Cyient shares jump 9% on revenue growth and dividend announcement
hook: Revenue growth and dividend lift Cyient shares
summary: Cyient reported a 25% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue to Rs 2,235 crore for the second quarter. Despite the revenue growth, net profit fell by 8% to Rs 132 crore during the same period. The company's board declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share for its shareholders. The DET segment performed well with robust revenue and new order intakes.

headline: Cyient jumps 10% on Q2 earnings and ₹12 dividend declaration
hook: Cyient surges 10% despite broker sell rating
summary: Cyient Ltd shares jumped 10%, snapping a three-day losing streak after reporting its second-quarter earnings and announcing an interim dividend of ₹12 per share. Meanwhile, brokerage Motilal Oswal Financial Services reiterated a 'Sell' rating on the stock with a sum-of-the-parts target price of ₹1,020. This target implies an 11% downside from the previous closing price of ₹1,144.
why_it_matters: Stock jumps post Q2 results despite brokerage sell rating.

headline: Cyient reports 7.7% revenue rise, 21.6% EBITDA growth, shares up 9%
hook: Cyient stock jumps on strong earnings
summary: Cyient posted a 7.7% sequential rise in revenue to Rs 2,235 crore for the July‑September quarter. EBITDA grew 21.6% to Rs 228.3 crore, lifting the margin to 10.21%. The results sent the stock up about 9% on the day. Investors see the earnings beat as a sign of improving profitability in the engineering services sector.
